BiblicalUsage: Kaumatizo means to scorch, to burn with the sun's heat. Matthew 13:6 says the seed on stony ground was scorched when the sun was up, because it had no root, and Mark 4:6 tells the same parable. Revelation 16:8 says power was given to the sun to scorch men with fire, and Revelation 16:9 says men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sun tests every plant: rootless seed withers, and scorched men curse God instead of repenting. I hold that the same heat that withers the shallow only hardens the deep-rooted.
